_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every upstream pin this repo depends on.
Nothing else in the tree may DECLARE a pin value. package.json and package-lock.json
files CONTAIN pin values, but they are derived: `tools/repin.py --check` fails if any of
them disagrees with this file, and `tools/repin.py --apply` rewrites them from it.
Prose that mentions a version must mention one of the versions declared here; the same
check enforces that, so a stale number in a README fails rather than misleads.
The re-pin POLICY (when to bump, what a bump must record) is PINS.md.

cpp.what: The C++ anchor. Base for every prepared upstream patch (M3, M4, M5, M9, M10), for the AVM_WASM build (M6), and for all reference material under reference/ except historical-protocol-specs/.

ts.identity: 4377ddf64c^ — the parent of 'refactor: remove the TS AVM simulator'
ts.what: The TypeScript anchor. The last commit at which yarn-project/simulator/src still contained the TS AVM and the public orchestration we reuse. Vendored into spike/src, diffsim/src and drift/src, and checked out as the worktree upstream/tsavm.

historical-protocol-specs.identity: 0285bb092b^ — the parent of 'chore(docs): Remove protocol specs from next'
historical-protocol-specs.what: The only commit at which docs/docs/protocol-specs/ still exists. Vendored into reference/historical-protocol-specs/. ABANDONED upstream on purpose; see reference/PROVENANCE.md before trusting anything from it.

_comment: Two @aztec/* nightly lines are in the tree at once, deliberately, and they are not
interchangeable. `current` is THE pin: new work uses it. `deletion_era` is frozen
evidence — the published line whose src/public tree is byte-comparable with the `ts`
anchor, which is what lets the deleted TS AVM run at all, and which still ships the
in-process NAPI AVM the differential oracle needs. Bumping `deletion_era` would destroy
the artefact rather than update it.

current.role: The pinned @aztec/* nightly. All new work uses this.

deletion_era.role: Frozen evidence. Do not bump; see PINS.md.

npm_exceptions._comment: @aztec-scoped packages that are NOT on the nightly line and must not be moved onto it. Each needs a reason; the check refuses any other exception.

@aztec/viem.why: A fork of viem republished under the @aztec scope, aliased in as `viem`. It follows viem's own versioning, not the monorepo nightly line, and no nightly of it exists.

@aztec/merkle-tree.why: The deleted TypeScript merkle trees (REUSE-INVENTORY.md RI-28). Upstream removed the package in e264dd4893 (2026-03-16), so this is the LAST nightly that ships it and no later one exists. Consumed only by probe-mt/, the probe that measured the undomained-hash defect. Pinning it forward is impossible, not merely undesirable.

npm_consumers._comment: Which declared npm pin each package.json/package-lock.json tree must use. Every @aztec/* dependency in these trees is checked against it.

toolchain._comment: Not upstream-Aztec pins, but pinned all the same; recorded here so there is one place to look. The authoritative declaration for each is the file named.
